paper_metadata.title: Crystal plasticity model for single crystal Ni-based superalloys: Capturing orientation and temperature dependence of flow stress

evidence.quote: We develop a dislocation density based crystal plasticity model to capture the micromechanical behavior ofγ′ strengthening nickel-based superalloys.

evidence.section: 4. Model application to single crystal Ni-based superalloys
evidence.quote: After implementing the model in the commercial FE framework of ABAQUS, it is applied to two different single crystal Ni-based superalloys, CMSX-4 and MD2.

A dislocation density based crystal plasticity model for γ-γ′ microstructure Ni-based superalloys is developed and implemented as a user material subroutine.
